basic_info.description: Top-floor view Edwardian condominium blends historic elegance with modern luxury. This renovated 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers 1,584 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, featuring exquisite details such as original wainscoting, beautifully refinished hardwood floors, and berber carpet in the view bedrooms. The inviting living room boasts a wood-burning fireplace with original tile surround, perfect for cozy evenings. The open kitchen is a chef's dream, complete with a center island, gas stainless steel appliances, and ample counter space, while a separate laundry room adds convenience. The shared lower yard, with its fruit trees and charming patio, provides a tranquil retreat for outdoor gatherings. This meticulously maintained building has seen recent upgrades, including new exterior stairs, fresh paint, front windows, a water heater, and a furnace. Ideally situated just steps from Noe Valley and the vibrant Valencia Street corridor, this is a can't beat location.
